mission: Sera moves before Ben can speak. Ancient containment protocols — the same techniques that sealed her in a wall for a thousand years — adapted to field conditions. Veraine in containment: conscious, intellectually furious, physically outmatched. Ben turns from the contained antagonist to the valley below, where Torin's void is still expanding.
why_now: The chapter's two-stage Veraine defeat completes here and the climax pivots to Torin. The group cannot rest; Maetha's warning is still in motion on the ridgeline across the valley.
conflict: Containment is not victory; it is deferral. Veraine contained is still Veraine. Torin's technique is still active. The resonance has done its work on Veraine, and another work is still waiting.
turning_point: Veraine in containment. Ben turns from the antagonist he has defeated to the friend he has not saved.
opening_hook: Sera moves before Ben can speak. Ancient containment protocols — the same techniques that held Veraine in stasis for a millennium, adapted to field conditions.
closing_hook: Torin. Still descending. His technique has created a zone of perfect unweaving around him, expanding as he approaches the Scar. He's not fighting the resonance — he's ignoring it. He has his own solution. And it's working. Maetha's warning echoes: 'It replaces you.'
emotional_trajectory: Relief at Veraine's containment -> immediate dread at Torin's continuing descent

stakes.personal: Ben must now face Torin — the person he could not save
stakes.interpersonal: Sera's role: containing Veraine while her heart breaks watching Torin
stakes.external: Torin's technique works but at catastrophic personal cost

setting: Veranthos — the valley, Veraine's position, then attention to Torin's descent
sensory_details: Sera's containment techniques — ancient, precise, efficient; Veraine's face in containment: fury and intellectual violation; Torin's void moving down the ridgeline toward the Scar, a zone of structured absence rather than the formless gone-ness of Kolven; the wrongness around Torin deliberate and directional, the technique at full expression
action_beats: Sera moves before Ben can speak — activating ancient containment protocols adapted to field conditions
Sera locks Veraine in a Force-containment field using techniques that held her in stasis for a millennium
Ben turns from the contained Veraine to look down the valley where Torin's void continues to expand
notes: The pivot from Veraine to Torin as the final crisis. Maetha's warning should surface as fragment ('replaces you'), not as quotation. Sera's use of containment discipline on the woman who shares her history is the chapter's quietest irony. Anti-pattern: Sera's containment work is discipline, not vengeance. Her face registers neither triumph nor pity — the room is a professional one. Voice: Zahn-quiet-efficient.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Veraine locked in containment; Ben's gaze shifts from the contained antagonist to Torin's descending void
turning_point_detail.shift: The scene's pressure inverts from 'can we stop Veraine?' to 'can we stop Torin?' — and Ben recognizes that containment is deferral, not victory. The friend he could not save is now the crisis he cannot avoid.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben must face Torin knowing he has failed to prevent this moment. Sera bears the secondary cost: she executes containment discipline on the woman who shares her thousand-year history while watching the person she loves descend into self-annihilation.

emotional_arc.start: Relief at Veraine's containment — the immediate pressure releases as Sera's discipline locks the antagonist away
emotional_arc.shift: The relief collapses into dread as Ben's attention pivots to Torin's continuing descent and he recognizes the true cost of containment: it solves nothing about what Torin is doing to himself
emotional_arc.end: Dread sharpening into helpless recognition — Torin's technique is working, which means Torin is succeeding at something Ben cannot stop

key_beats.beat_description: Sera moves before Ben can speak, activating ancient containment protocols—the same discipline that held her in stasis for a thousand years, now adapted to field conditions and directed at Veraine.
key_beats.state_change: The abstract pressure of Veraine's threat becomes concrete and locked. The antagonist transitions from active combatant to contained prisoner.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's relief is immediate and physical—a release of held breath, a loosening of braced shoulders. But the relief is incomplete; his attention is already fragmenting, pulled toward the valley below. The containment works, but it solves only one problem.

key_beats.beat_description: Sera locks Veraine in a Force-containment field, her face registering neither triumph nor pity—the room is a professional one. Veraine's fury and intellectual violation are visible in the containment, but Sera does not linger on them.
key_beats.state_change: Veraine is sealed. The two-stage antagonist defeat completes. But the valley below is still active; the resonance is still moving.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben sees Sera's discipline and recognizes the cost she is paying silently—containing the woman who shares her history while her heart breaks watching Torin. His relief begins to curdle into something sharper: the knowledge that stopping Veraine has not stopped anything that matters.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben turns from the contained Veraine to look down the valley, where Torin's void continues to expand—a zone of structured absence, deliberate and directional, the technique at full expression as he descends toward the Scar.
key_beats.state_change: The scene's pressure locks in at the boundary: Torin is not fighting the resonance; he is ignoring it. His technique is working. And it is working at a cost Ben cannot calculate because Torin will not let him see it.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Dread settles into Ben's chest—not the sharp dread of active threat, but the deeper dread of recognition. Torin's void is expanding because Torin is succeeding. The warning surfaces as fragment, not quotation: *it replaces you*. Ben understands, in that moment, that he has not saved Torin. He has only deferred the moment when he must watch his friend complete what he has chosen.

anti_patterns: Sera's containment work is discipline, not vengeance
Do not arrive at clinical articulation of the Force mechanics
Maetha's warning should surface as fragment, not quotation
Sera's face registers neither triumph nor pity—the room is a professional one
